<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Delivers req-22; builds c-limits. Depends on s05 (the request store holds the limit). Nothing is ever stopped. The opt-in quiet-seat watchdog is unchanged.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Roadmap 001 s12: a request can carry `--limit`; without one the role's default_limit applies (C5); when the limit passes with no output and no card update, pij sends the seat one check-in, and tells the PA (else the prime) if it goes unanswered, all inside the existing watchdog round.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Anything another roadmap step owns; see roadmap 001.

| ac-0001 | Check-in. | ac-0002 | Escalate. If the check-in goes unanswered (no output or card update by the next limit window), pij tells the PA (else the prime) once. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0002](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
- Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
- One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
